Various team and individual camps are offered throughout the summer and winter in a variety of sports. Below are dates and updated information. Check back to this page as information is updated as it becomes available.

Per bylaw 13.12.1.1 Attendance Restrictions: All University of Tennessee at Chattanooga sports camps and clinics are open to any and all entrants limited only by number, age, grade level and gender.
